# ADR-3007: A01: CORS reflection allow-list for origin set 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Reflecting Origin enables credentialed cross-site calls.

## Decision

Gateways SHALL NOT use a CORS reflection allow-list for origin set 7 (A01-7) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Explicit origin allow-lists replace reflection.
